key_parts.question: What is the current ECB deposit facility rate, and since when has it been in effect?

answer.question: What is the current ECB deposit facility rate, and since when has it been in effect?
answer.answer: As of 2026-11-19, the ECB deposit facility rate is 2.50%, and it has been in effect since 2026-09-16 [ecb_ecb_deposit_facility_rate].

chunks.text:
# ECB deposit facility rate

Source: ECB Data Portal, series FM/B.U2.EUR.4F.KR.DFR.LEV (Deposit facility - date of changes (raw data) - Level).

As of 2026-11-19, the ECB deposit facility rate is 2.50% (in effect since 2026-09-16).

Recent changes:
- 2026-09-16: 2.50%
- 2026-06-17: 2.25%
- 2025-06-11: 2.00%
- 2025-04-23: 2.25%

# ECB marginal lending facility rate

Source: ECB Data Portal, series FM/B.U2.EUR.4F.KR.MLFR.LEV (Marginal lending facility - date of changes (raw data) - Level).

As of 2026-11-19, the ECB marginal lending facility rate is 2.90% (in effect since 2026-09-16).

Recent changes:
- 2026-09-16: 2.90%
- 2026-06-17: 2.65%
- 2025-06-11: 2.40%
- 2025-04-23: 2.65%

# ECB publishes consolidated banking data for end-June 2026  
* PRESS RELEASE  
# ECB publishes consolidated banking data for end-June 2026  
6 November 2026  
* The aggregate of total assets of EU-headquartered credit institutions increased by 5.18%, from €33.27 trillion in June 2025 to €34.99 trillion in June 2026
* During the same period, EU credit institutions’ aggregate non-performing loans ratio[1] increased by 0.03 percentage points year on year to stand at 1.99% in June 2026
